theme_mode: Light Mode (Cool Canvas #F4F7FB) with High-Impact Gradient Accents

layout_and_spacing.density: Balanced density with generous section padding (p-6 to p-8)
layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-white border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200 p-6
layout_and_spacing.hero_banner_style: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#174EA6] to-[#4F7DF3] text-white rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden

kiosk_ui_specifications.clock_display: Server WIB Clock (Waktu Indonesia Barat) prominent top center, font-mono text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-bold text-[#4F7DF3]
kiosk_ui_specifications.touch_buttons: Min height 64px, rounded-2xl, active scale transition, high-contrast states
kiosk_ui_specifications.toggle_button: Reguler / Lembur segmented toggle with active state in Gradient Blue (#4F7DF3)
kiosk_ui_specifications.action_button: Alternating Masuk (Green #10B981) / Keluar (Red #EF4444) big touch panel
kiosk_ui_specifications.employee_search: Large touch keyboard / high visibility input for Employee Name or ID
kiosk_ui_specifications.confirmation_dialog: Modal dialog with 5-second auto-close timeout, clear employee avatar/details, and instant feedback alert

roles_ui_behavior.administrator: Full access to Dashboard, Employees, Attendance, Overtime, Kasbon, Payroll, Tutup Buku, Settings, Audit Log
roles_ui_behavior.operator_input: Restricted navigation bar — strictly limited to Today's Attendance view & manual check-in/out form
roles_ui_behavior.public_kiosk: Standalone token-linked route, no header/sidebar navigation, fullscreen touch optimized

tutup_buku_wizard.styling: Wizard stepper progress bar with active step in #174EA6, atomic transaction warnings, and downloadable payslip generator link

testing_attributes.mandatory: All interactive buttons, input fields, links, cards, tabs, and alerts MUST include unique kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components are built using React .js / .jsx (not TypeScript .tsx files).
Integrate lucide-react icons consistently throughout the app.
Use light background #F4F7FB with crisp white #FFFFFF cards for data readability.
Apply the main gradient linear-gradient(110deg, #174EA6 0%, #4F7DF3 100%) to hero cards, main dashboard header summary, and public kiosk highlights.
Ensure tables and forms remain light, crisp, and high-contrast (no gradient background on table rows).
Include Indonesian text for all user-facing labels (e.g., 'Absensi Hari Ini', 'Tutup Buku', 'Uang Muka / Kasbon', 'Gaji Pokok', 'Lembur', 'Jam Masuk', 'Jam Keluar').
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid AI slop, centered generic layouts, and heavy unnatural dark gradients.
Use subtle borders (#E2E8F0) and soft shadows for depth.
Never use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or modals — use solid bg-white with shadow-xl.
Ensure accessibility for focus and keyboard navigation.
Use Sonner for toast feedback alerts.
